app.name: PureSite
app.description: Build a static website as real files, preview it as it will ship, and publish it.

createEntities.label: Website
createEntities.description: Create a static website you can preview and publish.
createEntities.template:
Untitled site

Write the page in HTML. Preview it as it will ship. Publish it.

tools.name: fn_siteArchitectureBriefing
tools.description: Read a complete single-call site architecture briefing: site metadata, hashes for baseHash, ordered pages with link graph and promised pages, orphan/drift/contradiction lenses, design tokens with WCAG contrast, asset inventory by role, collections, verification state, and revision count.

includeStyles.description: Include the full shared styles/site.css text (default false).

includePromisedBriefs.description: Include sentence-derived briefs for promised unbuilt pages (default true).

tools.name: fn_pageDossierAndContent
tools.description: Call getSiteContext first for exact page paths. Inspect a single page in depth in one call: page and site hashes, URL, SEO and OpenGraph head metadata, heading outline, image alt coverage, link neighborhood and journey distance, page-specific checkSite/health/reach notes, optional deterministic answer to a question, and full HTML.

page.description: Page path (e.g. index.html or about/index.html). Defaults to the currently selected page.

includeHtml.description: Include full raw HTML document (default true).

question.description: Optional reader question to check deterministically against site copy via answerFor.

tools.name: fn_seoAccessibilityAndResponsiveAudit
tools.description: Call getSiteContext first for exact page paths. Run a unified SEO, accessibility, WCAG 2.1 contrast, link/stylesheet health, payload weight, and optional live responsive layout audit in one call. Returns a 0–100 score, launch grade, categorized findings, search/social preview, and recommended fixes.

page.description: Page path for search/social preview and optional responsive measurement. Defaults to selected page.

measureResponsive.description: Run live viewport responsive checks via checkResponsive at phone/tablet widths (default false).

widths.description: Viewport widths to measure when measureResponsive is true (default [390, 768]).

includePasses.description: Include passing audit checks alongside errors and warnings (default false).

tools.name: fn_scaffoldPageWithSections
tools.description: Call getSiteContext first for exact page paths and site baseHash. Create a new page or update an existing page with responsive Swiss-editorial section blocks and custom HTML, attach shared section styles automatically, apply SEO/OpenGraph head metadata, and optionally create 404.html in one call. Returns new hashes and immediate checkSite findings.

baseHash.description: The site hash from getSiteContext or fn_siteArchitectureBriefing. Required.

page.description: Target page path (e.g. "about", "work/index.html", or "index.html"). Defaults to selected page for append/replace.

mode.description: create adds a brand-new page; append inserts sections into an existing page (default); replace replaces <main> (or body content) on an existing page.

sections.description: Ordered list of section library IDs (hero, editorial-split, feature-grid, metrics-strip, pricing-tiers, testimonials, faq-accordion, contact-form, cta-banner, site-footer) or objects with { id?, markup?, beforePath?, afterPath? }.

head.description: Optional SEO/OpenGraph/language head metadata to apply to the page.

create404.description: Create a branded 404.html starter page if not already present.

tools.name: fn_polishThemeSeoAndNavigation
tools.description: Call getSiteContext first for exact page paths and site baseHash. Apply a coordinated design-token theme preset or token overrides, batch page titles and SEO/OpenGraph head metadata, missing html lang fixes, 404.html creation, and nav reordering in one call. Returns WCAG contrast grades, before/after preflight scores, and updated hashes.

baseHash.description: The site hash from getSiteContext or fn_siteArchitectureBriefing. Required.

preset.description: Optional Design Studio preset (swiss-editorial, warm-paper, obsidian-ink, high-contrast-clear, signal-bold).

tokens.description: Optional partial Design Studio token overrides merged over current or preset tokens.

pageMeta.description: Batch updates to page titles and SEO/OpenGraph head metadata.

fixMissingLang.description: Set <html lang="..."> on every page that lacks a lang attribute (e.g. "en").

ensure404.description: Add a branded starter 404.html page if none exists.

navOrder.description: Optional complete ordered list of page paths for nav order (must list every existing page once).

tools.name: fn_prePublishReadinessCheck
tools.description: Run a complete pre-build and pre-publish readiness check in one call: combines checkSite findings, preview verification state, preflight SEO/accessibility score, link/journey/contradiction lenses, planned build/ file manifest and unused assets, collection storage requirements, and published record status. Publishing itself remains human-only in the Publish dialog.

includeFileManifest.description: Include every planned file entry in build/ (default true).

includeLlmsPreview.description: Include generated llms.txt preview text (default false).

tools.name: getSiteContext
tools.description: Return the open site: title, package path, the site hash, every page with its URL path, title and its own hash, the nav order, the stylesheet, the files attached and what each is for, the user's current selection when they have clicked an element in the preview, the verification state (verified / checking / failed, with reasons in plain words), how many revision snapshots exist, and where the site is published. Call this first, always — a page path or element path guessed without it is usually wrong. Every write takes baseHash: a page's hash for page tools, the site hash for writeStyles, movePage and the collection tools.

tools.name: readPage
tools.description: Call getSiteContext first to get exact page paths. Return the full HTML of one page with its hash. Pass that hash as baseHash (with page) to writePage or to an element tool on that page.

page.description: Page path, e.g. index.html or work/index.html

tools.name: writePage
tools.description: Replace one page's HTML. Requires baseHash — the page hash from readPage; refused with "changed since your read" when the page moved meanwhile, in which case call readPage again and redo the edit. The previous site is snapshotted first (listRevisions / restoreRevision). Lay content out in flow — never position children absolutely at fixed offsets, or they overlap when text wraps at a different width. Link the stylesheet with the right number of ../ for the page's depth: a wrong link previews unstyled because it ships unstyled.

baseHash.description: The page's hash from readPage (or getSiteContext's pages[].hash). Checked against that page only; refused when the page changed since your read — read it again and redo the edit.

tools.name: addPage
tools.description: Call getSiteContext first for existing pages and site baseHash. Add a page to the open site. A name without .html becomes a folder with an index.html, so 'about' serves at /about/.

html.description: Optional full document; a starter page is written when absent

baseHash.description: The site hash from getSiteContext. Refused when the site changed since your read — call getSiteContext again and redo the edit.

tools.name: writeStyles
tools.description: Replace the site stylesheet. One stylesheet governs the whole site, so a change here changes every page. Requires baseHash — the site hash from readStyles or getSiteContext; refused when the site changed since your read.

baseHash.description: The site hash from getSiteContext. Refused when the site changed since your read — call getSiteContext again and redo the edit.

tools.name: exportPage
tools.description: Export a page from the open site to a PDF or full-page PNG for review. Defaults to the current page. Saves a new file under the site package reviews/ folder and returns outputPath and artifactPaths. Does not publish or send anything. Drafts can be exported. Call getSiteContext first.

page.description: Exact page path returned by getSiteContext; defaults to current page.

width.description: PNG layout width in CSS pixels. Defaults to current preview width. PDF uses A4 browser pagination.

tools.name: saveSite
tools.description: Save the current site into its app-managed .site package and return the durable artifact path. Call this after site edits before completing a mission.

tools.name: buildSite
tools.description: Write build/ — every page, the stylesheet and the assets in use — and return the manifest of files with their sizes. Refused, with the reasons, while the site is not verified: a blocking finding from checkSite, a page that scrolls sideways, or a preview not yet measured (it re-checks first). Publishing is NOT a tool: the person publishes from the Publish dialog, which runs the same check.

tools.name: discoverAppTools
tools.description: Discover PureSite's extended specialist tools (27 tools across assets, audit, brand, collections, drawer, elements, navigation, pages, revisions, styles) and composite functions (6 workflows). Prefer calling exposed composite functions and core tools first; use discoverAppTools when an edge case needs a specialist tool, then call it via callExtendedReadTool (for read-only tools) or callExtendedTool (for mutating tools).

query.description: Optional keywords describing the capability you need (e.g. "assets", "audit", "brand", "collections", "drawer").

category.description: Optional category filter (assets, audit, brand, collections, drawer, elements, navigation, pages, revisions, styles, or "all").

names.description: Optional exact tool names to fetch full JSON input schemas for.

includeFunctions.description: Include already-exposed composite functions and core tools in the listing (default false: searches extended tools first).

tools.name: callExtendedReadTool
tools.description: Call one of PureSite's read-only extended specialist tools discovered via discoverAppTools (categories: assets, audit, brand, collections, drawer, elements, navigation, pages, revisions, styles). Strictly refuses mutating, destructive, external, or release tools.

tool.description: Exact name of a read-only extended tool from discoverAppTools.

arguments.description: Arguments object matching the tool’s inputSchema.

tools.name: callExtendedTool
tools.description: Call one of PureSite's mutating extended specialist tools discovered via discoverAppTools (categories: assets, audit, brand, collections, drawer, elements, navigation, pages, revisions, styles). For destructive tools, set confirmDestructive: true after checking with the user. Strictly refuses read-only tools (use callExtendedReadTool), external tools, permanent-delete tools, and release tools.

tool.description: Exact name of a mutating extended tool from discoverAppTools.

arguments.description: Arguments object matching the tool’s inputSchema.

confirmDestructive.description: Required (true) when calling an extended tool marked risk: "destructive".
